note: Parameter declaration skeleton, one entry per workbook rule. The typed declarations (type, unit, default, status DEFINED/UNDEFINED) are written in Phase 1 with the generalised registry; ITSM already has them in health/rules/itsm/parameters.json.

ITOM-001.workbook_text: CIDR overlap analysis, not string matching. Report by subnet with device count.

ITOM-002.workbook_text: Default threshold 85%. The expected-count derivation must be shown alongside the ratio.

ITOM-004.workbook_text: Any empty location on an active schedule

ITOM-005.workbook_text: Require evidence the range is still live: recent incidents, recent events, or non-stale CIs from another source

ITOM-007.workbook_text: Class staleness thresholds configurable; compare against the tightest threshold among classes present

ITOM-008.workbook_text: Majority threshold default 90% of range unreachable

ITOM-010.workbook_text: Any overlap. Escalate where reclassification churn is present in the overlap.

ITOM-011.workbook_text: Escalate where the range contains CIs supporting Business Critical services

ITOM-012.workbook_text: Capability profile derived from MID host specification where available; otherwise from observed throughput

ITOM-013.workbook_text: Requires the customer's schedules to be defined; report the absence if they are not

ITOM-015.workbook_text: Default 70% failure rate sustained for 3 consecutive days. Escalate at 14 and 30 days.

ITOM-016.workbook_text: Device type inference from port signature and partial classification

ITOM-017.workbook_text: Any sustained failure. Temporal correlation with the credential update timestamp strengthens the root-cause claim.

ITOM-019.workbook_text: Affinity coverage threshold default 80% of successfully discovered devices

ITOM-021.workbook_text: Privilege classification configurable; derive from the credential's account role where available

ITOM-022.workbook_text: Ratio threshold configurable, default scope 5x actual success footprint

ITOM-023.workbook_text: Device type from successful classification or port signature

ITOM-024.workbook_text: Fires only where a vault capability exists on the instance

ITOM-025.workbook_text: Rotation period from the customer's policy, not assumed. Report the absence of a policy separately.

ITOM-028.workbook_text: Default threshold 85%. Report by range and by phase.

ITOM-029.workbook_text: Requires at least 5 runs. Flag on positive trend with projected overrun within 90 days.

ITOM-030.workbook_text: Report by range and by port signature to identify the device family

ITOM-031.workbook_text: Report with the resulting CI quality, not just the phase count

ITOM-035.workbook_text: Correlate by device identity and run timestamp

ITOM-036.workbook_text: Depth and age thresholds configurable; age is the more meaningful of the two

ITOM-041.workbook_text: Requires sufficient execution volume on both; default minimum 50 executions

ITOM-043.workbook_text: Failure rate threshold default 60% with minimum volume 20

ITOM-044.workbook_text: Timeout rate threshold default 30% with minimum volume 20

ITOM-045.workbook_text: Deprecation status from the instance's own metadata

ITOM-046.workbook_text: Compare against the pattern version shipped with the current family

ITOM-048.workbook_text: Minimum duplicate count per pattern configurable

ITOM-051.workbook_text: Criticality determined by the services the range's CIs support

ITOM-052.workbook_text: Resolve through the CMDB host relationship where available; otherwise compare host identifiers

ITOM-054.workbook_text: Compare major and minor version against instance

ITOM-055.workbook_text: Any unvalidated MID in production use

ITOM-056.workbook_text: Warning window default 30 days. Escalate inside 7 days.

ITOM-058.workbook_text: Disproportion threshold default 2x the cluster mean

ITOM-060.workbook_text: Thresholds from MID configuration where available

ITOM-063.workbook_text: Required role set per work type; admin on a MID account is always flagged

ITOM-065.workbook_text: Any unconfigured MID; escalate where disk utilisation is trending up

ITOM-066.workbook_text: Threshold default 90 days with no heartbeat

ITOM-067.workbook_text: Any non-zero value is notable. Default threshold 10%.

ITOM-068.workbook_text: Default threshold 60%. Current means refreshed within its interval.

ITOM-069.workbook_text: Requires Service Mapping licensed and pattern coverage confirmed

ITOM-070.workbook_text: Window aligned to the map refresh interval

ITOM-076.workbook_text: Tier model derived from the best-mapped services in the estate

ITOM-077.workbook_text: Report as an estate-wide ratio, not only per service

ITOM-082.workbook_text: Only fires where traffic-based data collection is available

ITOM-083.workbook_text: Exact match on address and port

ITOM-085.workbook_text: Tool detection from CI classes, integration endpoints and credential types

ITOM-086.workbook_text: Threshold from the connector's own interval

ITOM-087.workbook_text: Default 70% drop against a rolling baseline. Baseline must account for weekday and weekend variance.

ITOM-090.workbook_text: Liveness evidence from source CIs, credentials or other integrations

ITOM-091.workbook_text: Age is the more meaningful threshold; default 15 minutes

ITOM-094.workbook_text: Class coverage evaluated with hierarchy expansion

ITOM-095.workbook_text: Default threshold 85%. Report by source and by class.

ITOM-098.workbook_text: Report by node format to identify the systematic cases

ITOM-099.workbook_text: Any occurrence within a detected duplicate set

ITOM-100.workbook_text: Fires where the rule's class set contains duplicates

ITOM-101.workbook_text: Retired state set from instance configuration

ITOM-103.workbook_text: Format classification: FQDN, short name, IP, MAC, composite

ITOM-104.workbook_text: Participating class set from the impact configuration

ITOM-105.workbook_text: Any disabled rule with live event volume in its class set

ITOM-107.workbook_text: Fires only on a full-population zero

ITOM-109.workbook_text: Age threshold by severity; default 4 hours Critical, 24 hours Major

ITOM-110.workbook_text: Default 60% in a single band. Report by source, since one source usually causes it.

ITOM-111.workbook_text: Report by alert type to find the systematic gaps

ITOM-112.workbook_text: Any occurrence with non-zero firing count

ITOM-114.workbook_text: Co-occurrence threshold configurable; requires relationship data to identify the pattern

ITOM-115.workbook_text: Default 20% of total volume from a single node

ITOM-117.workbook_text: Correlation by dedup key and node

ITOM-119.workbook_text: Report by rule to identify the systematic cases

ITOM-120.workbook_text: Account evidence from cloud CI account identifiers and integration references

ITOM-124.workbook_text: Tolerance default 2x interval; cloud intervals are typically short

ITOM-125.workbook_text: Scope to cloud classes expected to participate in the service model

ITOM-127.workbook_text: Any exclusion without a registered justification

ITOM-128.workbook_text: Required permission set per provider and discovery scope

ITOM-129.workbook_text: Requires a successful recent discovery run; absence during a failed run is not evidence of termination

ITOM-130.workbook_text: Required tag set from the customer's policy; report the absence of a policy separately

ITOM-131.workbook_text: Availability per provider and resource type

ITOM-133.workbook_text: Match on instance ID, private IP, MAC or hostname

ITOM-135.workbook_text: Requires cloud discovery to be working; guard on ITOM-121 coverage

ITOM-144.workbook_text: Attribute comparison set and tolerance configurable

ITOM-145.workbook_text: Age threshold default 90 days; environment from tags or used_for

ITOM-147.workbook_text: Requires failure onset date and per-CI staleness; attribute only CIs whose staleness began after onset

ITOM-148.workbook_text: Deletion attribution requires audit retention covering the window

ITOM-149.workbook_text: Requires both the rule criteria and the integration's attribute payload

ITOM-150.workbook_text: Any occurrence; report as a count and as a share of total alerts

ITOM-152.workbook_text: Any Business Critical service with a structurally impossible impact result

ITOM-153.workbook_text: Requires MID availability history and audit retention covering the window

ITOM-155.workbook_text: Guard on cloud discovery run success; absence during a failed run is not evidence of termination

ITOM-156.workbook_text: Both counts computed, not estimated. Report the rule list by name.
